parrafo_1.es: Handyman Haim es un negocio de handyman con sede en Fort Lauderdale, dirigido por Haim, a quien varios clientes llaman 'Mr. Haim'. Se especializa en window treatments (roller shades, shades motorizadas, shutters y persianas) y en reparaciones generales del hogar: extension de baseboards, reemplazo de puertas, reparacion de techo e instalacion de drenaje de ducha.
parrafo_1.en: Handyman Haim is a Fort Lauderdale handyman business run by Haim, who several customers call 'Mr. Haim.' He specializes in window treatments (roller shades, motorized shades, shutters and blinds) and in general home repairs: baseboard extension, door replacement, ceiling repair and shower tile and drain installs.

parrafo_2.es: 50 resenas en Google y una calificacion de 5.0 cuentan la misma historia: Haim es confiable, con precios justos y responde personalmente por mensaje de texto. Varios clientes lo han llamado de nuevo para distintos proyectos en la misma casa.
parrafo_2.en: 50 Google reviews and a 5.0 rating tell the same story: Haim is reliable, fairly priced, and answers personally by text. Several customers have called him back for different projects at the same home.

items.quote: I am very happy with the Manual Roller Shades from Handyman Haim. The shades have a modern look, work smoothly, and provide excellent privacy and light control. The quality is impressive, and the installation was completed professionally.

I highly recommend Haim for home repairs and improvements. He completed several projects at my home including baseboard extension, door replacement, ceiling repair, and shower tile/drain install. All projects were completed in a timely manner and to my satisfaction. Haim is reliable, affordable, and gets the job done.
We're so happy with our shutters and blinds, which I bought from Handyman Haim. The shutters are beautiful and the installation was superb. I would use them again and recommend them to everyone!
